class.name: ExpHeightFog
class.brief_description: Unreal-style exponential height fog as a screen-space pass.
class.description: Applies exponential height fog by reconstructing world position from the depth buffer and integrating density = [member density] * exp(-[member falloff] * (h - [member ref_height])) along each view ray. Add it anywhere in a 3D scene; it draws a fullscreen pass over the viewport. For correct results the active [Camera] environment must keep the depth buffer available (the default forward GLES3 path does).

members.member: Master on/off. When false the pass outputs zero alpha (no cost beyond a transparent draw).
Fog density at [member ref_height]. Higher is thicker. UE "Fog Density".
Height falloff. Larger values confine fog closer to [member ref_height]; smaller values let it rise higher. UE "Fog Height Falloff".
World-space Y where density equals [member density] (the fog "sea level").
Distance from the camera before fog begins. UE "Start Distance".
Upper clamp on fog opacity. UE "Fog Max Opacity".
Base fog color. UE "Fog Inscattering Color".
Enables sun-tinted glow when looking toward [member directional_light_direction].
Color of the directional inscattering glow.
Direction the light travels. Set this to your DirectionalLight's forward (-Z) vector.
Tightness of the glow. Higher concentrates it nearer the light vector.
